story.title: The Silence Debt
story.logline: A woman discovers that every word she speaks in public has a physical weight she must carry home.
story.theme: The hidden cost of modern communication.
story.twist: The heavy objects in her apartment are not debts from speaking, but material manifestations of every word she failed to say to her dying sister.
story.ending: If silence weighs this much, how heavy is an unsaid goodbye?

scenes.narration: My living room is slowly crushing me beneath three hundred pounds of solid lead furniture.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 28, messy dark hair, oversized grey hoodie, trapped in a tiny cluttered apartment filled with heavy grey metallic blocks. Vertical format.
scenes.camera: Close-up on her strained face, slow push in.

scenes.narration: Every unnecessary sentence spoken out in the city materializes inside my apartment the moment I unlock the door.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 28, dark hair, grey hoodie, dropping her keys inside the same tiny apartment now crowded with heavy blocks.

scenes.narration: Today at work, I argued with my boss for five minutes. Now a massive iron desk blocks my kitchen.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 28, dark hair, grey hoodie, staring angrily at a giant rusted iron desk blocking her kitchen doorway.
scenes.camera: Wide angle, low angle looking up.

scenes.narration: Small talk is a luxury tax I can no longer afford. Yesterday's gossip cost me a concrete pillar.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 28, dark hair, grey hoodie, touching a rough concrete pillar that appeared in her narrow hallway.

scenes.narration: I tried whispering on the phone. The tiny steel cubes piled on my bed still bruised my ribs.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 28, dark hair, grey hoodie, sitting on the edge of a bed half-filled with sharp little steel cubes.

scenes.narration: So I stopped talking completely. For weeks, I uttered not a single word to anyone.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 28, dark hair, grey hoodie, sitting silently in an empty patch of floor, lips tightly pressed together.

scenes.narration: Yet tonight, returning home, the floorboards groan under the weight of something entirely new and impossibly massive.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 28, dark hair, grey hoodie, opening her apartment door to find a colossal, glowing stone monolith.

scenes.narration: It isn't made from the careless words I said out loud. It is built from the silence I kept.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 28, dark hair, grey hoodie, pressing her bare palm against the warm, glowing monolith.
scenes.camera: Close-up on her hand and the glowing stone.

scenes.narration: This is the exact weight of the final words I never told my sister before she passed away.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 28, dark hair, grey hoodie, tears streaming down her face as she looks up at the towering monolith.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up, tears catching the light.

scenes.narration: If silence weighs this much, how heavy is an unsaid goodbye?
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 28, dark hair, grey hoodie, slowly embracing the massive warm stone as the room fades to shadow.
scenes.camera: Wide cinematic shot, slowly pulling away.

caption.hook: Every word spoken leaves a physical weight.
caption.title: The Silence Debt
caption.caption:
She thought the heavy objects filling her apartment were the cost of small talk. But silence has its own crushing gravity.

What are you leaving unsaid?
